fact: The US State Department says that during most of 2024 asylum and refugee status determinations were not considered, owing to government and UNHCR contractual and administrative impediments.
UNHCR, with ONARS, registered 24 new-arrival households (29 people) in the period reviewed and issued 199 certificates and 14 identity cards in the Holl-Holl camps and Djibouti-ville.
UNHCR states that registration of new arrivals and refugee status determination, suspended in February 2024, had not yet resumed as of May 2024.
UNHCR says it and ONARS registered 14 households of 18 individuals in Djibouti-ville on 28 January 2025 and that 122 attestations were printed and delivered, 108 renewals and 14 for new arrivals.
UNHCR Djibouti reports it renewed 128 documents under continuous registration in March 2024, 121 family attestations and 7 refugee identity cards.
UNHCR reports MENFOP helped 158 refugee teachers in Ali Addeh and Holl-Holl open bank accounts at East Africa Bank.
UNHCR reports 158 refugee teachers were helped to open East Africa Bank accounts.
